g.text: CONSTRAINT (non-negotiable): $0 extra · one Hetzner node · personal use
DRIVING — the top few that shape the design
EXPLICITLY TRADED AWAY — it's a single-user tool

div.p: Architecture characteristics are prioritised, not maximised. Naming the top 3 (security, learnability, evolvability) tells you what to optimise and what to sacrifice (scale, HA). The $0 / one-node constraint is the wall the whole design lives inside — a given, not a characteristic you trade.

text.tspan: scoped token · transient data · least privilege

g.text: accepted because it serves ONE reader
